import numpy as np
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    freq=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    colors=[v for v in freq if v!=0]
    mark=min(colors,key=lambda v:freq[v])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==mark]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    mh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
        for c in range(w-mw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=mark
    return out
